summary: Re-test of KanbanCard height fix. Improvements verified (line-height 1.2, padding 6px top/bottom, -webkit-line-clamp:2 applied), but cards STILL exceed the 80px ceiling. New range: 81.4-85.9px (down from 91.7-96.2px in iter4). Spec requires <=80px — 9/9 cards FAIL. Backend /api/health = 200.

ui_bugs.issue: All 9 kanban cards still exceed the 80px height ceiling after the tightening fix. Measured heights: TO DO (2 cards) 85.9px each, IN PROGRESS (3 cards) 85.9px each, DONE (4 cards) 81.4px each. Required: <=80px. Verified styles ARE applied: paddingTop=6px, paddingBottom=6px, title fontSize=11px, lineHeight=13.2px (1.2 ratio), -webkit-line-clamp=2, -webkit-box-orient=vertical, overflow=hidden. Even the DONE cards with single-line titles (e.g., 'Wireframes — all 8 pages approved', 'Brand guidelines and asset handoff') are 81.4px — 1.4px over the cap, meaning the non-title chrome (tag row + title margin + footer margin + footer row + 12px vertical padding) alone already pushes ~81px before any 2-line wrapping. Two-line title cards add ~4.5px more (note: less than a full 13.2px line, suggesting clamp constraint is partially helping but the baseline is still over).

action_items: Card baseline (single-line title) is already 81.4px — 1.4px over the 80px cap. To get under 80px on every card you need to shave ~6px off the 2-line cards and ~2px off the 1-line cards. Recommended additional tightening (any one or combination): (a) reduce card padding from 6px to 4px top/bottom (saves 4px), (b) drop title marginTop and footer marginTop from 4 to 2 each (saves 4px), (c) drop tag row fontSize from 9 to 8 / padding 2px 6px to 1px 5px (saves ~2-3px), (d) switch -webkit-line-clamp from 2 to 1 with text-overflow:ellipsis so titles never wrap (saves 13.2px on the worst cards but loses readability on long titles), (e) shorten title strings to fit in one line at 178px column width.
NOTE: card width measured at 178px, not the assumed ~210px. Column is narrower in render; that's why most titles still wrap to 2 lines.
critical_code_review_comments: The webkit clamp setup uses display:flow-root in the computed style snapshot, not display:-webkit-box. Modern browsers still honour -webkit-line-clamp on flow-root in some cases, but the canonical recipe is display:-webkit-box + -webkit-box-orient:vertical. Verify the title element has display set explicitly to '-webkit-box'; if it's relying on author-default and the browser is reporting flow-root, the clamp might not be enforced consistently across browsers.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Card heights now 81.4 (single-line title) to 85.9 (two-line title) — improved ~10px from iter4 but still over the 80px cap. Title CSS confirmed: fontSize 11, lineHeight 13.2 (1.2), -webkit-line-clamp 2, padding 6px/6px. Column inner width is 178px (narrower than the ~210px assumed). The single-line baseline (81.4px) means just tightening padding/margins is the cleanest path to <=80px; 2px reduction anywhere (e.g., padding 6->4 OR title margin 4->2 + footer margin 4->2) takes single-line cards under 80, and combined with the existing clamp keeps two-line cards under too. Use page.evaluate with simple JS strings — multiline triple-quoted JS via page.evaluate can trip the script wrapper parser; pass as a single-line string. Skip entry animation with: document.querySelectorAll('.r, .split, .story-bar').forEach(el => el.classList.add('in', 'go')); then scroll to [data-testid='client-kanban'] and measure [data-hover] children.
rca_of_the_issue: Bug: kanban cards still 81.4-85.9px tall, over the 80px requirement. Root cause split into two parts: (1) Single-line baseline 81.4px = 6px topPad + ~12px tag row (9px font + 2*2px padding + ~3px line-height) + 4px title marginTop + 13.2px title (1 line) + 4px footer marginTop + ~14px footer row + 6px botPad ≈ ~59px theoretical, but real ~81 due to flex/grid spacing and natural inline-block leading on small text. The chrome alone busts the cap by 1.4px. (2) Two-line title cards add only ~4.5px (not full 13.2px) because clamp engages but renders a partial second line, putting them at 85.9px. Mitigation: any 2px reduction in a non-title element (padding 6->4, or marginTop 4->2 on either title or footer) brings single-line cards under 80px; combined with the already-applied clamp this keeps two-line cards under as well. Alternative: clamp to 1 line entirely (single-line ellipsis) — most aggressive, single 13.2px savings on worst cards, but trades off legibility.
